purpose: Reference family discovery only; not completeness or local runtime conformance evidence.

families.title: Package lifecycle and templates
families.local_surface: new/open/save/to_bytes/copy/close; Document.edit succeeds for conservative PDF only
families.remaining: OpenXML package editing does not establish Office layout/preservation. Source DOCX editing, template variants and cross-document composition remain gated.

families.title: Ordered body/rich text and editing
families.local_surface: Paragraph.text/add_run/find/replace_text/slices; native explicit breaks; ordinary recipes
families.remaining: Top-level insertion/deletion/move needs stable locator redesign; cross-document Fragment does not remap the complete resource/semantic graph. Decimal/bar tabs remain rejected.

families.title: Character and paragraph properties
families.local_surface: Paragraph/TextRange/Style formatting and shared defaults; direction and language reuse native properties
families.remaining: Bounded direction/language evidence covers selected mixed-script layout. Broader complex-script/CJK typography, font controls and diagnostics remain open; no wrapper per XML property.

families.title: Named styles and inheritance
families.local_surface: styles.add/style.format/based_on/next/linked/defaults; recipes use existing handles
families.remaining: Default font-size clear differs between model11pt and reader10pt; arbitrary default-style selection resolves via Normal; next-style-on-enter is editor-only; style import/remapping unassessed.

families.title: Number definitions, levels and sequence starts
families.local_surface: Paragraph.set_list(kind,level,restart,start) includes native nine-level decimal_outline in checked top-level body scope; extracted definitions and evaluated labels are tested separately
families.remaining: Custom definitions/picture bullets, auxiliary/cell/multicolumn outline placement and broader counters remain open; source templates retain native 64-character truncation limits.

families.title: Table topology, nested cells and rich content
families.local_surface: Existing table/cell/paragraph handles; grid CRUD; bounded merge/split; native rich-cell paths
families.remaining: Unsafe vertical-merge mutations rejected; complete legal merge/split algebra is not established by model methods. No parallel cell text/style framework.

families.title: Table and row geometry/pagination
families.local_surface: column_widths/fit/row.height/repeat_header/allow_split; native page-bound overflow guards
families.remaining: Non-splittable oversized rows can lose content natively; local serialization rejects. Measurement caps4000paragraphs; widths reuse starting column on continuation.

families.title: Table/cell borders, margins, shading and conditionals
families.local_surface: Table.format/Cell.format and style.format(region=...); shared formatting values
families.remaining: Cell spacing, patterned shading and full edge conflict resolution require upstream work; direct table fill differs from conditional/whole-style fill. Vertical double/wave/triple/dot-dash borders rejected.

families.title: Table descriptions and visible caption association
families.local_surface: Table.format(title=...,description=...); extracted table metadata
families.remaining: Alternative text is implemented and distinct from visible captions, counters and PDF Table/TR/TH/TD tagging. Native source text caps10000characters.

families.title: Page dimensions, margins, columns and section transitions
families.local_surface: Section page_size/margins/gutter/columns/column_widths/start; stable sections collection
families.remaining: Per-column gap control, mirrored/top gutters and detailed layout inspection are not covered by current profile; avoid redundant orientation API.

families.title: Headers, footers and page-specific linkage
families.local_surface: Section.header/footer(default/first/even) reuse paragraphs/tables/pictures and owned clear(); copies retain independent parts, while missing/repeated clear is a true no-op
families.remaining: Link-to-previous/unlink and arbitrary block movement remain open. Inactive variants may lack measured cell geometry; rich notes are separate.

families.title: Page/count fields, line numbering and refresh semantics
families.local_surface: Paragraph.add_field(page/page_count/section_page_count), Section.page_number_start; Section.line_numbers reuses native decimal counters
families.remaining: Explicit Arabic supported. Continuous SECTIONPAGES/restarts are rejected; implicit numeral context differs across body/stories; no general field evaluator. Numbered sections are single-column; affected continuous each_page resumes are rejected. Line-label bounds/work do not imply complete numbering parity.

families.title: Footnotes and endnotes
families.local_surface: Notes collection plus shared Paragraph handles; section note_options/configure_notes
families.remaining: Full continuation/section placement and unsupported custom styles remain bounded by existing native acceptance. Endnote collector field scopes already guarded.

families.title: Hyperlinks, bookmarks and cross-references
families.local_surface: TextRange.link supports external URLs and internal links; whole-paragraph/endpoint body bookmark mapping reuses existing ranges, with checked horizontal nested-cell targets and tested PDF destinations
families.remaining: Interior/cross-paragraph/imported targets, non-body bookmark targets and general cross-reference evaluation remain unsupported or unassessed.

families.title: TOC, captions, index and bibliography sources
families.local_surface: No general reference authoring engine; ordinary literal recipes do not satisfy evaluated references
families.remaining: Schema nodes store instructions/data; deterministic evaluated results and layout synchronization require native field support and diagnostics.

families.title: Page color, image backgrounds, borders and watermark composition
families.local_surface: WordDocument.background/background_image; paragraph/cell shading; existing slide background/image
families.remaining: DOCX frame stretch implemented. Tiling silently stretches in PDF above4096tiles/below1pt; watermark scale/alpha/rotation differs; page-border fidelity unassessed.

families.title: Inline/floating images and anchor positioning
families.local_surface: Owned Picture data/size/alt/crop/flips; related SlidePicture uses native placement
families.remaining: DOCX rotation has native ink loss. Floating positioning/wrapping needs native geometry/copy/serialization proof; opacity not inferred from transform fields.

families.title: Drawing fills, shapes, text boxes and groups
families.local_surface: Existing PDF path primitives and PPTX shapes/text/backgrounds; no duplicate shape-building framework
families.remaining: DOCX arbitrary drawing/textbox/group editing unassessed; PDF underlay API lacks public placement option; render-transparent backdrop differs from authored fill.

families.title: Theme colors, fonts and embedding references
families.local_surface: Explicit colors/font names and bounded PDF supplied fonts are implemented
families.remaining: Native theme font availability is not established by Theme model; DeckCraft bundledCRAFT_FONTS empty; font assets require attribution/size audit.

families.title: Charts and cached series data
families.local_surface: Extraction projections/diagnostics only; no chart-builder facade
families.remaining: WordCraft unsupported-only chart placeholder or omitted mixed-series kinds need diagnostics; broader authoring/render/export semantics unassessed.

families.title: Equations and structured math
families.local_surface: Existing imported equation projection; no equation API
families.remaining: Presence of native math/diagram types does not prove editable shape/layout/export parity; separate bounded corpus needed.

families.title: Structured content controls and data bindings
families.local_surface: Existing literal replacement/batch recipe is independent of true controls
families.remaining: Typed read/create/bind/lock semantics and repeating controls remain unassessed; no raw XML binding surface or local template engine.

families.title: Comments and revision representation/resolution
families.local_surface: Imported bounded stories/anchors/diagnostics only; no review editor API
families.remaining: Formatting revision resolution is located in excluded application engine; move/re-export pure library operation upstream. Comment anchor editing needs balanced-ID proof.

families.title: Custom document property inventory
families.local_surface: WordDocument.metadata/update_metadata(custom=...); typed bounded scalar read inventory
families.remaining: Unsupported variants and source cap/trim omissions are explicit; no arbitrary XML variant API.

families.title: Extended application properties
families.local_surface: No new parallel metadata collection
families.remaining: Pinned WordCraft app_xml passthrough uses private kept-property policy, not a public editable model; language/app metadata remain DOC7 gaps.

families.title: Compatibility, layout and protection settings
families.local_surface: Selected existing settings through typed section/style methods
families.remaining: Do not infer encryption from DocumentProtection or permit macro/embedded program execution; exact setting-by-setting native behavior remains unassessed.

families.title: Slides, layouts, masters, notes and navigation
families.local_surface: Slides/layouts/typed shapes/text/tables/images/notes/internal links with stable IDs
families.remaining: Whole-slide import/copy needs public graph re-ID/remapping; comments lose shape anchors/deep replies; PDF artwork rasterized; imported preservation unassessed.

families.title: Package/schema validation boundary
families.local_surface: Local archive/resource boundary checks and detected omission diagnostics
families.remaining: SDK validation is not an Office layout oracle. ArtCraft needs operation-scoped preservation reports; no SDK runtime dependency or raw-package API.

families.title: PDF opening, creating, saving and serialization
families.local_surface: new/open/edit/copy/save/to_bytes/close; PDF-only conservative source editing; object_streams selects native full-writer representation on serialization
families.remaining: Incremental/encryption/repair and broader preservation profiles remain independent gaps; representation selection does not expand imported editing.

families.title: Page subset, insertion, copying, ordering and deletion
families.local_surface: PdfPages add/insert/move/delete and PdfDocument.copy(pages=...)
families.remaining: Basic assembly is complete; unsupported document/form structures retain explicit guards. Generic DOCX composition is a different problem.

families.title: Positioned text and font authoring
families.local_surface: PdfPage.draw_text point/box; native supplied-font profile; no alternate text engine
families.remaining: Native supplied-font wrapping/strict clipping and selected font reuse limits require upstream primitives or explicit bounded rejection.

families.title: Flowed HTML/story reports and tables
families.local_surface: DOCX paragraph/table report recipe then native PDF conversion
families.remaining: Keep this a recipe using existing native layout. Do not introduce HTML/CSS or second report builder to imitate Story object hierarchy.

families.title: Image insertion, replacement and removal
families.local_surface: Existing owned Office picture operations and PDF add_image use native media APIs
families.remaining: Source PDF image replacement/removal, arbitrary alpha/blends/underlays and non-PNG authored profiles require separate native acceptance.

families.title: Vector paths, fills and paint ordering
families.local_surface: PdfPage.draw_path; typed PPTX shape properties
families.remaining: Native public stamping forces overlay; private prepend support must be exposed upstream. Do not wrap every draw in an adapter-built Form/layer system.

families.title: Source PDF page-as-form/background composition
families.local_surface: No facade for arbitrary source-page Form composition
families.remaining: Native Form traversal silently caps4096visits/depth12; bounded aggregate decoding/UserUnit correctness and public overlay control needed.

families.title: DPI rasterization, clipping and alpha behavior
families.local_surface: render_page/get_pixmap return encoded PNG; region clip; private retained native sessions
families.remaining: Explicit output alpha/backdrop replacement is not proven; DeckCraft can return blank fallback after panic; do not add Pixmap wrapper.

families.title: Text geometry, links, tables and source grounding
families.local_surface: Owned normalized blocks/cells/links and source metadata; eager open, selected extract_text and retained native PDF Page.search_for with bounded ordered rectangles
families.remaining: Native PDF table detector remains private. Exact Office line slices and broader provenance are open; search is not OCR, regex, visible-only matching or normalized-offset reconstruction.

families.title: Markdown, chunking and structured extraction
families.local_surface: to_markdown/export_markdown and normalized owned values; no RAG chunk framework
families.remaining: PyMuPDF2.0 already documents these APIs; packaging/licensing/Office semantic coverage can differ, not generic novelty. Chunk metadata is reference-only.

families.title: Links, outlines, metadata and page labels
families.local_surface: Owned bookmarks/links/metadata and preserved imported labels; no combined reference engine
families.remaining: Current named-destination/outline depth limits and unsupported document properties need explicit profiles; broader page label authoring is separate acceptance.

families.title: Annotation operations and appearances
families.local_surface: Existing note/markup/link and bounded rectangle/ellipse annotation handles and typed properties; strict boolean lock for seven canonical comment kinds
families.remaining: Fixed-profile geometric comments do not establish opacity/fill/reply or arbitrary appearance support. Caller-bounded native inventories remain upstream work; PDF annotations are distinct from tracked DOCX review. Local locked exposes only the native editing-lock bit, excludes links, and is not arbitrary flag editing or access control.

families.title: Interactive widgets and field values
families.local_surface: PdfFields/PdfField owned text/checkbox/choice profile with geometry/value updates and bounded Unicode tooltip metadata
families.remaining: Imported enumeration silently truncates/loses widgets/unknown kinds; require public fallible bounded inventory before safe general source-form editing. Script/signature behavior is excluded. The local tooltip is an empty string when absent; this is not a promise to match the reference field-label fallback or imported metadata behavior.

families.title: Redaction markers versus irreversible content removal
families.local_surface: No secure redaction runtime API promised
families.remaining: Native vertical writing unsupported; vector/shading residual semantics and aggregate bounds insufficient. Overlay rectangles never substitute for removal.

families.title: Cleanup, encryption, incremental save and embedded files
families.local_surface: PDF save/to_bytes select object streams or classic cross-reference full output; neither is a new conversion pair or archival profile
families.remaining: General cleanup/compression and incremental/encrypted output remain unassessed. Page FileAttachment creation is public; document EmbeddedFiles mutation remains private. Native strict caller-limited full-chain decoding exists; bounded complete attachment inventory, unambiguous identity and integrated bounded extraction remain upstream work. Arbitrary encryption/active-content/PDF-A/UA profiles are unassessed. No raw PDF object escape hatch.

families.title: Separate Office product reference
families.local_surface: Existing Office render/extract uses permissive pinned native crates without runtime license service
families.remaining: Office reference is separate commercial product; it already renders Office pages. This does not establish an editable DOCX authoring API or market uniqueness.
